verdict.rationale: An in-browser interactive tutorial is a fair thing to ask of a web framework, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a local setup path: cargo install, scaffolding with proa new, and a dev server on localhost:3000. Nothing documents a browser playground, online sandbox or interactive tutorial that needs no local install.

support.subject: As a developer, I can try an in-browser interactive tutorial to learn the framework hands-on without any local setup
